behavior.aggregation: Combine eligible physical requirements for the same material across accepted queued jobs, including different output recipes.
behavior.auction: Buy one qualified commodity quote or complete legacy lot per press. Protect individual accepted quantity and price bounds and apply each exact quantity and copper share. Classic can adopt an individually approved lot when a combined stack is unavailable.
behavior.vendor: A single validated live offer can cover planned vendor requirements and approved merchant alternatives for auction requirements. Preserve each accepted budget, whole-bundle limits, FIFO receipt allocation, and pending auction/mail exclusion.
behavior.bank: Use one scoped group withdrawal. Validate physical stack and scope after each move, including after the first order is credited. Partial bank receipts allocate in FIFO order. A stale group revision fails even when total demand matches.
